headline_marked: Thousands [[camp in New Delhi]] to demand Education Minister's resignation
headline: Thousands camp in New Delhi to demand Education Minister's resignation
summary: Youth-led 'cockroach' movement protests against medical entrance exam leaks and systemic higher education failures in India.
details: Thousands of supporters of the youth-led 'cockroach' movement are camping in New Delhi, demanding the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan.
The protests were triggered by the cancellation of the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) after question papers were leaked, leading to about a dozen student suicides.
NEET is the sole gateway to undergraduate medical courses in India, where millions compete for fewer than 150,000 seats, creating immense pressure on students.
The movement, which gained millions of Instagram followers, channels the frustration of India's under-30 population regarding high youth unemployment and recurring exam leaks.
Protesters are also demanding the release of fasting activist Sonam Wangchuk and compensation of 10 million rupees each for the families of students who died by suicide.
While the government has promised exam reforms and punishment for those behind the leaks, thousands remain at the sit-in site after facing tear gas and baton charges during previous marches.
Opposition groups, including the Congress party, have joined the cause, seeing it as a major challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi's youth vote base in his third term.

headline_marked: Gopalganj: [[Trainee lawyer injured by paperweight]] allegedly thrown by judge
headline: Gopalganj: Trainee lawyer injured by paperweight allegedly thrown by judge
summary: Sabiha Sultana was struck on the head during court proceedings after the judge reportedly threw the object to silence loud talking in the courtroom.
details: A trainee lawyer, Sabiha Sultana, was injured after being struck by a paperweight allegedly thrown by a judge in the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court in Gopalganj.
The incident happened around 12:30 pm in court no. 2, when judge Md Sujon Mia reportedly threw the paperweight from his desk after repeated warnings to people talking loudly during a hearing.
Sabiha, who was reviewing documents at the time, was hit on the head and subsequently rushed to the 250-bed Gopalganj General Hospital for treatment.
Advocate MA Alam Selim, general secretary of the District Bar Association, stated that while the judge may not have intentionally targeted her, such an incident is unacceptable.
Following the incident, lawyers met with the chief judicial magistrate and requested that the judge be removed from conducting proceedings in that court for the time being.
The court's proceedings will now be overseen by another judge, while higher judiciary authorities hold the power to formally discipline or remove the judge.
caption:
A trainee lawyer was hit by a paperweight thrown by a judge to silence a noisy courtroom in Gopalganj.

A trainee lawyer, Sabiha Sultana, was injured after being struck by a paperweight allegedly thrown by a judge in the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court in Gopalganj.

The incident happened around 12:30 pm in court no. 2, when judge Md Sujon Mia reportedly threw the paperweight from his desk after repeated warnings to people talking loudly during a hearing.

Sabiha, who was reviewing documents at the time, was hit on the head and subsequently rushed to the 250-bed Gopalganj General Hospital for treatment.

Advocate MA Alam Selim, general secretary of the District Bar Association, stated that while the judge may not have intentionally targeted her, such an incident is unacceptable.

Following the incident, lawyers met with the chief judicial magistrate and requested that the judge be removed from conducting proceedings in that court for the time being.

The court's proceedings will now be overseen by another judge, while higher judiciary authorities hold the power to formally discipline or remove the judge.
